alignments.note: Displaced by the possessive: the genitive pronoun hymon is present to carry 'your', so the article realizes nothing and the case preposition 'of' stays with the noun (rules 20, 21).
Source noun rendered 'of + noun'; head on the noun (rules 17, 21).

Greek is anarthrous, so the supplied 'the' is a rule 7/51 helper on the noun; the appositional 'even' is likewise licensed by this noun and is not mechanically 'added' (rule 11). A reading marking 'even' as 'added' remains defensible.
Anarthrous noun: the supplied possessive 'your' has no other source word to belong to and rides with the noun, as does the case preposition 'of' (rules 7, 11, 21).
